sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to extend their excellent recent form. The league leaders sit top with 22 points from 10 games and have won their last match, maintaining a strong run of W-D-W-W-W. Alsager sit bottom of the table with just 4 points from 10 games and have lost their last five matches, making them heavy underdogs in this encounter.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host basement-dwellers Widnes Town at home. Stafford are chasing Sandbach after a recent draw and sit on 20 points, while Widnes have mustered only 2 points and remain without a win this season. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, face Eccleshall at home in a mid-table clash; Eccleshall are fifth but hit a recent loss and will be looking to bounce back. Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community in a fixture between two sides looking to consolidate their mid-table positions. Bilston Town (sixth, in-form with recent wins) host Foley Meir in what should favour the visitors' hosts. Barnton, in seventh place on a recent winning streak, welcome Shawbury United, who are struggling with five consecutive defeats. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a battle between sides in the lower reaches of the table. Cheadle Heath Nomads face a tough assignment away at Telford Town, with both teams struggling near the bottom and searching for consistency. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a clash of teams with limited recent success. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town at home and will be hoping to build on their recent win against an out-of-form side.
